style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="251" y="535" width="240" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="t2do4PLRTwAlxmi5EZEO-7" value="<div align="left"><ol><li>Colors are necessary and show inside vs outside cell</li><ol><li>can be diff colors but not vivid</li></ol><li><div>A(c)/B(c) must stay inside Cell</div></li><ol><li>A(e)/A(c) must stay outside cell</li></ol><li>All arrows and directions must keep directions relative to inside cell</li><ol><li>Arrow going up/down/left/right does not need to stay</li></ol><li>Keeping Exchange A and B as close together as possible is ideal</li><li>Curve Arrow shows Rxn Bio (A) which uses A(c) to create Bio1 and B(c), arrows must convey this</li><li>Arrow Directions</li><ol><li>All Diff must have arrows going both ways</li><li>All EX Bio1/2 must have arrow point out of box (unidirectional)</li><li>All EX A/B must be birectional</li></ol><li>Add a Legend that shows (Legend must easily be movable)</li><ol><li>Name of Reaction with long form name</li><li>Shapes and their meaning (Metabolites are diamonds, etc)</li><li>Color represents "intracellular compartment"</li><li>Inner boxes represent the individual metabolic model</li><li>Outer box represents outside the models (shared media)</li></ol><li>Each outer box must show the name Situation 1, 2, etc. with space to add more description later</li></ol><div>Like to have</div><ol><li>Try to make the blank space smaller and text bigger (easier for fitting into paper)</li><li>Try to make inner models symmetric in shape</li></ol></div>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="SaCgthawVII2sQZ9w-ac-1"> <mxGeometry x="251" y="535" width="240" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="SaCgthawVII2sQZ9w-ac-125" value="<div align="left"><ol><li>Colors are necessary and show inside vs outside cell</li><ol><li>can be diff colors but not vivid</li></ol><li><div>A(c)/B(c) must stay inside Cell</div></li><ol><li>A(e)/A(c) must stay outside cell</li></ol><li>All arrows and directions must keep directions relative to inside cell</li><ol><li>Arrow going up/down/left/right does not need to stay</li></ol><li>Keeping Exchange A and B as close together as possible is ideal</li><li>Curve Arrow shows Rxn Bio (A) which uses A(c) to create Bio1 and B(c), arrows must convey this</li><li>Arrow Directions</li><ol><li>All Diff must have arrows going both ways</li><li>All EX Bio1/2 must have arrow point out of box (unidirectional)</li><li>All EX A/B must be birectional</li></ol><li>Add a Legend that shows (Legend must easily be movable)</li><ol><li>Name of Reaction with long form name</li><li>Shapes and their meaning (Metabolites are diamonds, etc)</li><li>Color represents "intracellular compartment"</li><li>Inner boxes represent the individual metabolic model</li><li>Outer box represents outside the models (shared media)</li></ol><li>Each outer box must show the name Situation 1, 2, etc. with space to add more description later</li></ol><div>Like to have</div><ol><li>Try to make the blank space smaller and text bigger (easier for fitting into paper)</li><li>Try to make inner models symmetric in shape</li></ol></div>"
